text: dsh-token-usage 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端的本机 Token 用量统计插件。它在侧边栏增加统计页面，从已存会话日志汇总模型回报的用量，并提供按模型、提供商、主会话与子会话、预设和日期查看的统计。用户可以切换全部、近 30 天、近 7 天或今天，也能手动刷新并查看最近会话。统计通过本机页面接口提供，代码读取会话持久化记录及当前进程中的会话；无需配置 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-token-usage is a DeepSeek Harness web dashboard for token use across saved sessions. Its sidebar groups totals by model, provider, session type, preset, and date. Choose all time, 30, 7, or 1 day, refresh, and review sessions. It reads local data; no API key or external service is declared.

[English](README.en.md) · [分享文案](docs/share.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) · [MIT](LICENSE)

装好后侧边栏面板列表里会多出一个「Token 用量」入口，点开是一整页统计：

- **一共烧了多少**：合计 / 输入 / 缓存命中 / 输出 / 请求数 / 会话数
- **哪个模型占了多少**：每个 `提供商 + 模型` 的请求数、输入、缓存命中、输出、合计、占比条、最近使用时间
- **花在哪里**：按会话类型（主会话 / 子会话）、按预设（agent preset）、按提供商对照
- **什么时候花的**：全部 / 近 30 天 / 近 7 天 / 今天一键切换；最近几天、最近会话排行

全部**离线**完成：数据只来自本机的会话日志，不发任何网络请求，也不上报到任何地方。

@local/dsh-token-usage README · 统计口径：- **总 token** = `inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens + outputTokens`，并与事件自带的 `totalTokens` 取**较大者**（个别适配器只报三个字段，或不含缓存字段）。
- **输入 / 缓存命中 / 缓存写入 / 输出** 分别累加，互不重复计入总和。
- **请求数** = 带 `usage` 的 `assistant/message` 事件条数；**会话数** = 至少有一条用量事件的会话数。
- 缓存读取通常占绝对多数（多轮对话里每轮都要重放上下文），所以「输入」这一栏会远小于「合计」，这是正常的。
- 事件里的 `usage` 是**模型真正回报的用量**，不是估算值；这与 Harness 单会话的用量气泡完全同源。

几个值得记下来的实现要点：

@local/dsh-token-usage README · 它是怎么做到的：- **`inject` 声明不是可选的**：Host 半用 `export const inject = ["webServer", "sessionPersistence", "sessions"]`。Cordis 的 `ctx` 是 Proxy，**没在 `inject` 里声明的服务一读就抛错**，而 `?.` 只挡 `null`/`undefined`、挡不住抛出的异常 —— 少写一个服务名会让整轮扫描被 try/catch 静默吞掉，面板上表现为「数字全是 0」。
- **时间窗口按天分桶**：一次扫描就把「某天 → 每模型计数」存下来，切 range 只是内存里的 Map 合并，因此来回切不碰磁盘；`?range=` 的结果按 range 记忆化，任何一次新扫描都会让缓存失效。
- **滚动列的 flex 守卫**：`.dstu_body>*{flex:0 0 auto}` 必须留着。flex 子项的 `overflow` 只要不是 `visible`，浏览器就把它的自动最小尺寸当作 0 —— 于是 `overflow:hidden` 的卡片会被压成几像素、`overflow:auto` 的表格被压成 0，页面看起来就是「下半截不见了，还滚不动」。这条守卫把每个子项钉在自然高度上。
- **路由只信本机同源请求**：`Host` 必须是 loopback 或绑定地址，带了 `Origin` 就必须和 `Host` 一致，`sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 直接拒绝，非 GET/HEAD 返回 405。

@local/dsh-token-usage README · 常见问题：**「近 30 天」和「全部」的数字一模一样？**
如果本机有用量记录的历史不足 30 天，30 天窗口会覆盖全部数据，两者**必然相等**，这不是 bug。要确认窗口真的在生效，用「今天」或「近 7 天」对照。

**面板显示「无法读取用量索引」/ 数字全是 0？**
Host 半扫描失败。最常见的原因是 `export const inject` 里漏了服务名（见上文实现要点）；先看 Harness 日志里的 `dsh-token-usage: scan failed: …`，面板在有 `error` 时也会把原始错误直接显示出来。

**页面下半截看不到、也滚不动？**
滚动列的 flex 子项被压扁了，`.dstu_body>*{flex:0 0 auto}` 这条守卫就是为了挡它；`node scripts/harness-layout.mjs` 会专门验证这件事。

**会不会把用量上报出去？**
不会。插件没有任何出站请求：唯一的网络行为是 Harness 自己拿着会话日志去调用模型，而本插件只是读那些日志。

@local/dsh-token-usage README · Features：| | |
| --- | --- |
| Data source | Read-only access to `~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v4.jsonl.zstd`; nothing is written, no session data is modified, no other plugin's DOM is touched |
| Trustworthy numbers | Same definition as Harness' built-in `tokenUsage` projection, so the panel matches the usage pill inside an individual session |
| Model grouping | `message.source.provider` + `message.source.model` are authoritative; a duplicated `provider/` prefix is stripped (only when it is actually compatible with the provider), so one model never splits into two rows |
| Incremental scan | Each session's `revision` is checked: unchanged sessions reuse their previous ledger, changed ones only read the tail after the last `seq`. First full scan of 220+ sessions / 8700+ usage events takes ~1–2 s; every later request is a cache hit |
| Time windows | The scan buckets by **local calendar day** (`YYYY-MM-DD`) right away, so switching between today / 7 days / 30 days only merges those buckets — no disk access |
| Theme and language | Only `--dsw-alias-*` design tokens, so it follows the light/dark theme automatically; Chinese and English UI |

@local/dsh-token-usage README · How tokens are counted：- **Total** = `inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens + outputTokens`, compared against the event's own `totalTokens`, and the **larger** of the two wins (some adapters report only three fields, or omit the cache fields).
- **Input / cache read / cache write / output** are accumulated separately and are never double-counted into the total.
- **Requests** = number of `assistant/message` events that carry `usage`; **sessions** = sessions with at least one usage event.
- Cache reads usually dominate (every turn of a multi-turn conversation re-sends the context), so the "input" card is much smaller than the total. That is expected.
- The `usage` in those events is what the **model actually reported**, not an estimate, and it is the very same source Harness uses for a single session's usage pill.

A few implementation notes worth keeping:

@local/dsh-token-usage README · How it works：- **`inject` declarations are not optional.** The host half uses `export const inject = ["webServer", "sessionPersistence", "sessions"]`. Cordis' `ctx` is a Proxy, so **reading an undeclared service throws**, and `?.` only guards `null`/`undefined` — it does not catch a thrown error. Miss one service name and the whole scan is silently swallowed by the surrounding try/catch, which shows up as "all the numbers are 0".
- **Time windows are bucketed by day.** A single scan stores "day → per-model counters", so switching ranges is just a Map merge in memory and never touches the disk; results are memoized per range and invalidated by any new scan.
- **The flex guard on the scroll column** (`.dstu_body>*{flex:0 0 auto}`) must stay. A flex item whose `overflow` is not `visible` gets an automatic minimum size of 0, so `overflow:hidden` cards shrink to a few pixels and an `overflow:auto` table shrinks to nothing — the page then looks like "the lower half vanished and it will not scroll". The guard pins every child at its natural height.
- **The route only trusts local same-origin requests**: `Host` must be loopback or the bound address, a presen

@local/dsh-token-usage README · FAQ：**"Last 30 days" shows exactly the same numbers as "All".**
If your machine has less than 30 days of usage history, the 30-day window covers everything and the two are **necessarily equal**. That is not a bug. Use "today" or "last 7 days" to confirm the window is really applied.

@local/dsh-token-usage README · FAQ：**The panel says it cannot read the index / every number is 0.**
The host half's scan failed. The most common cause is a missing service name in `export const inject` (see above). Check the Harness log for `dsh-token-usage: scan failed: …` — the panel also prints the raw error when the payload has one.

@local/dsh-token-usage README · FAQ：**The lower half of the page is invisible and it will not scroll.**
A flex child of the scroll column got squeezed; the `.dstu_body>*{flex:0 0 auto}` guard exists precisely to prevent that, and `node scripts/harness-layout.mjs` verifies it.

**Does it report my usage anywhere?**
No. The plugin makes no outbound requests at all: the only network traffic is Harness itself talking to your models, and this plugin merely reads those session logs.
@local/dsh-token-usage README · Development and self-checks：No running Harness needed. All four scripts are **assertion based** (they throw and exit non-zero on failure, so no eyeballing numbers):

@local/dsh-token-usage README · Development and self-checks：```bash
node scripts/check-helpers.mjs     # pure functions: counting, model-name normalisation, time windows, origin checks (31 assertions)
node scripts/harness-host.mjs      # runs the host half against real session logs + a real HTTP route (four ranges, 403/405/HEAD)
node scripts/harness-dom.mjs       # renders the page in jsdom and asserts the numbers and labels, incl. that a range switch really shrinks them
node scripts/harness-layout.mjs    # measures the real CSS in headless Edge: every block keeps its height and the column scrolls

@local/dsh-token-usage README · Development and self-checks：- `harness-host.mjs` uses a **Proxy** as its fake ctx which throws `cannot get property "<name>" without inject` exactly like Cordis, so a missing service name reproduces locally. It also recomputes the expected per-range values from the raw logs to cross-check the plugin's output.
- `harness-dom.mjs` needs jsdom/react/react-dom, installed into `.verify/node_modules` (never into the package):

```bash
  npm install --prefix .verify --no-save --no-package-lock jsdom react react-dom
  ```

@local/dsh-token-usage README · Development and self-checks：- `harness-layout.mjs` injects the package's **real CSS** into the framework's real ancestor chain, measures it, then strips the guard rule and reruns — the stripped run **must** reproduce the old "card squashed to 0" bug, otherwise the check is not testing anything.
